title: How the test is structured
description: Official HEC Scholarship Aptitude Test format, confirmed from the HEC sample paper.

title: Verbal reasoning
description: 50 questions — synonyms/antonyms, sentence completion, and vocabulary-in-context.
points: e.g. 'Choose the word similar in meaning to DEBACLE' → Fiasco
Focus on precise vocabulary — memorize meaning, not just synonyms

title: Quantitative reasoning
description: 30 questions — algebraic manipulation, arithmetic, and applied word problems.
points: Time-pressure friendly: practice mental shortcuts over long calculation
Past papers repeat question *styles* even when numbers change

title: Analytical reasoning
description: 20 questions — logic puzzles with ordering/sequencing constraints.
points: Classic 'schedule 6 activities under 5 conditions' style puzzles
Draw the sequence out — don't try to hold constraints in your head
Practice eliminating options against each condition one at a time
